outputs.explanation: These are spatial transcriptomic heatmap overlays on tissue sections showing log2 expression intensity per spot; this is a heatmap-type visualization, not a bar chart of averages, so individual data points are not applicable.
This panel consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
This is a dot/scatter plot showing each individual patient tumor value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual data points are the data itself and are clearly displayed.
This is a bar chart of mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each of the n=3 replicates per group, satisfying the requirement to show underlying data alongside the average.
